correctness.rationale: From the exact Gaussian Landweber recurrence, derive \(\Gamma_K=\sigma^2\omega f_K(\omega B)\). The unique interior root follows from one turning point of the explicit polynomial \(H_K(u)\); this proves both the positive uniform result and sharp counterexample for any larger ceiling. Rescale \(t=c/K\) to obtain the unique positive root \(e^c=1+2c\). For even \(K\), the explicit 45-degree two-eigenvalue model gives \(f_K(2-\epsilon)\sim K^2\epsilon^2/2\); rank-one best approximation then yields the exact divergent error ratio. Four Rademacher outcomes give diagonal probe variance \(\gamma^2/(4N)\), hence its squared ratio. Finite standard-library verifier ran 4997 supplementary checks, including exact rational identities, but infinity claims rest on the analytic derivation. Domain, step endpoints and noise normalization are specified.

value.rationale: Choosing normal-operator leading modes is a natural and explicitly used surrogate for covariance uncertainty quantification. The exact \(K\)-dependent ceiling determines when this choice genuinely captures leading propagated-variance modes without reading covariance eigenvalues; a mismatch occurs already for the nonovershooting scaled spectrum \(\{1,2/3\}\). The even-step two-mode construction quantifies potentially unbounded waste in covariance rank budget and fourth-order relative waste in simple residual-diagonal probe variance as the stable step approaches its ceiling. These are mathematically motivated operator-rank and sampling-cost boundaries, not an arbitrary enumeration or a global failure claim about a paper's corrected estimator.
